name: eventcheckin
author: Taako
description: Discord event registration with persistent RSVP and check-in controls, capacity limits, automatic waitlists and promotion, reminders, attendance/no-show finalization, role rewards, and CSV exports.
install_msg: EventCheckin loaded. Create an event with `[p]eventcheckin create <unix_timestamp> <capacity> <title>`.
short: RSVPs, waitlists, reminders, attendance check-ins, no-shows, and rewards.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores event configuration, channel/message/role IDs, event creator IDs, attendee Discord user IDs, RSVP/waitlist/check-in/no-show states, notes, timestamps, and staff actor IDs. CSV attendance reports are generated on demand.
